mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO points_bucket (bucket_id, user_id, amount, remain, expire_at, reason_type, ref_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{bucketId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{remain}, #{expireAt}, #{reasonType}, #{refId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, bucket_id, user_id, amount, remain, expire_at, reason_type, ref_id, create_time, update_time FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW() ORDER BY expire_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE points_bucket SET remain = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND bucket_id IN #{bucketId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(remain), 0) FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND remain > 0 AND expire_at > NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE points_bucket SET remain = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE expire_at <= NOW() AND remain > 0
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_bucket WHERE user_id = #{userId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM points_detail WHERE user_id = #{userId})
